name: cartelera
description: AI video studio — animate photos, make ads, series and music videos with original songs. Plans for free and only spends tokens after you approve the quote.

interface.longDescription: Turn an idea into a finished video with Cartelera's hosted studio: animate a photo or a painting, make a commercial, a short series, a house tour or a music video with an original song. The script, scene photos and music are planned for free; animating scenes shows the exact token cost and only runs after you approve.
defaultPrompt: Animate my grandparents' wedding photo into a short video with a love song
Make a 30-second vertical ad for my taco shop
Create a music video for a corrido about my hometown
